query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='canonical-web-and-design/ubuntu.com' AND number=9785 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox
data.body:
NVDA is a Windows screen reader used by blind individuals to read what's on screen. It appears your site has some sort of cookie banner that NVDA does not read in Firefox. I was able to access the site using Chrome, but it's really a hassle having to switch browsers, especially when this is not a terribly difficult problem to fix. Thanks.

---
*Reported from: https://ubuntu.com/server/docs/install/storage*

data.title: ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox
data.body: Thank you for taking the time to report this issue. I will look into it today.

data.title: ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox
data.body:
I believe this is related to this issue: https://github.com/nvaccess/nvda/issues/2745. I have replicated the behaviour in both Firefox which does not work and Chrome which does. I believe the markup should read the landmark as the region is focused but I am no expert. 

Does anyone else have any other suggestions?

data.title: ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox
data.body: @anthonydillon, this has something to do w/the way this alert is being coded, methinks. If it'd just be changed to a simple dialog w/an "ok" or "got it" button or equivalent, I think everything would be fine.

data.title: ubuntu documentation site not working NVDA Firefox
data.body: @abletec I believe this problem was fixed by another PR (https://github.com/canonical-web-and-design/cookie-policy/pull/123) in July - I've just tested the site with NVDA, and from what I can tell it seems to be OK, but please let us know if not.
